items.titolo: Modders bring Nvidia’s DLSS 5 Neural Rendering to AMD Radeon GPUs
items.descrizione: An unofficial project is bringing Nvidia’s DLSS 5 to AMD Radeon GPUs, with early testing showing performance climbing from around 30 FPS to 50 FPS in Cyberpunk 2077 after rapid optimization.
